title: PostgreSQL write path trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for postgresql-write-performance trace events. Every duration is in microseconds of modelled time, produced by a fixed cost model rather than measured on a real server.

table.description: Name of the write-only table this scene models.

config.description: The decisions currently in force. Every one of them re-prices a row.

payloadBytes.description: Size of one record's business payload, wherever it ends up living.

payloadPlacement.description: Whether the payload is a column in this table or a reference to an external store.

rowBytes.description: Size of the row PostgreSQL actually has to write.

compressible.description: True for text/JSON/XML; false for already-compressed binary data.

columnCompression.description: False once the column is SET STORAGE EXTERNAL, which skips the compression attempt.

commitMode.description: Whether a commit waits for the WAL flush (synchronous_commit on/off).

poolSize.description: Connections the service shares between every caller of its API.

row.description: What writing ONE row costs under the current configuration.

storedBytes.description: Bytes written to the heap and TOAST pages, after any compression.

walBytes.description: Bytes written to the write-ahead log for the same row.

toastChunks.description: Chunk rows the value is sliced into; 0 when the value stays inline.

indexEntries.description: Index entries written per row: the primary key plus every secondary index.

requestUs.description: End-to-end cost of one row-by-row INSERT: the sum of every part below.

parts.description: The write split into its cost components, in execution order. Parts costing nothing are omitted.

name.description: Which stage of the write this slice belongs to.

lastWrite.description: The most recent write call; null before anything has been written.

strategy.description: How the rows were sent to the server.

batches.description: Statements sent: 1 per batch, 1 for a COPY, 1 per row otherwise.

flushes.description: Commits that waited for an fsync; 0 with synchronous_commit = off.

pool.description: The last burst of API callers measured against the pool; null until serveApi is called.

clients.description: Callers submitting a record at the same moment.

drainUs.description: How long the whole burst takes to clear at the effective capacity.

capacityPerSec.description: Writes per second the service actually absorbs: the lower of the two ceilings.

poolCeilingPerSec.description: Ceiling imposed by connections times per-write cost.

diskCeilingPerSec.description: Ceiling imposed by table + WAL bytes against the volume's write bandwidth.

boundBy.description: Which ceiling is binding. Adding connections only helps when this is 'pool'.

totals.description: Everything this scene has written so far.
